faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Research Assistant position at IIITDM Kancheepuram?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Research Assistant position at IIITDM Kancheepuram is 31st August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Research Assistant post at IIITDM Kancheepuram.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Assistant role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.A. in English, Linguistics, Social Science, or Education, along with proficiency in both Tamil and English (spoken and written).

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Assistant position is 40 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 37,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is online.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the Research Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The job type for this Research Assistant position is contractual.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply for the Research Assistant role?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification and the application link in the "Important Links" section of this article, or by visiting the official website of IIITDM Kancheepuram.
